features.name: Create invoices
features.description: New document from the + button on the invoice list. The editor has three blocks in order: your business details, the client, the line items (description, rate, quantity, amount), then totals (subtotal, discount, tax, total, balance due), notes and signature. Number and dates are prefilled.
features.reason: The whole purpose of the app. Pure local data plus a PDF render.

features.name: Estimates and one-tap conversion to invoice
features.description: Estimates live in their own tab with the same editor. A button at the bottom of the estimate turns it into an invoice with the same client and items.
features.reason: Listed first in the listing and in the help centre; a local copy between two document kinds.

features.name: Receipts
features.description: After an invoice is marked paid, a receipt can be sent to the client showing the payment.
features.reason: Listing promises receipts; it is a variant of the paid invoice PDF.

features.name: PDF preview and export
features.description: Edit / Preview / History tabs on the document screen. Preview shows the rendered page; the document can be saved as PDF or printed.
features.reason: The invoice is the PDF. PDFKit or UIGraphicsPDFRenderer on device.

features.name: Send by email, SMS, WhatsApp
features.description: Arrow button opens the choice of email or text; the screenshot shows the system share sheet with the PDF (AirDrop, Messages, Mail, Dropbox).
features.reason: Share sheet and MFMailComposeViewController send the PDF without any server.

features.name: Business details and logo
features.description: Settings hold business name, address, contacts, business number and logo shown in the document header.
features.reason: Required on every invoice. Logo from Photos via PhotosPicker.

features.name: Bank / payment details
features.description: Payment instructions (bank details) printed at the bottom of the invoice.
features.reason: How a client actually pays without an online processor.

features.name: Client from contacts
features.description: Pick the client from the phone's contacts to fill name, email, phone and address.
features.reason: Contacts picker (CNContactPickerViewController) needs no permission prompt.

features.name: Taxes and discounts
features.description: Tax set in Settings: on the total, deducted (withholding), or per item for multiple rates; with rate, label and inclusive switch. Discount as percentage or fixed amount.
features.reason: Every invoice needs them. Pure arithmetic, testable.

features.name: Product photos on the invoice
features.description: Photos with captions attached under the totals (screenshot 1).
features.reason: Local images embedded in the PDF.

features.name: Signature
features.description: Signature drawn on the device, printed with the signing date.
features.reason: Listed in the listing and screenshots; PencilKit on device.

features.name: Templates and colour
features.description: Seven layouts (four free, three paid) and an accent colour from presets or hex.
features.reason: One clean layout is enough for Sbu; colour choice conflicts with the single-accent rule and needs a decision.

features.name: Mark paid and payment method
features.description: Button at the bottom of the editor records the payment and method; the list shows due dates in red when overdue.
features.reason: Paid / unpaid status is local data.

features.name: Invoice history list
features.description: Invoice tab lists client, number, amount and due date, overdue in red, with a floating + button. Bottom tabs: Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Payments, More.
features.reason: Main screen.

features.name: Read receipts and status notifications
features.description: Push notification when the client opens, pays or the invoice comes due.
features.reason: Opened/paid tracking needs a hosted link and a server. A local due-date reminder is possible without it.

features.name: Online payments (card, PayPal, Stripe, QR to pay)
features.description: Client pays from a hosted invoice page or a QR code printed on the invoice.
features.reason: Requires accounts with a processor and a server.

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Expenses tab, receipt photo saves key information.
features.reason: A second job; Sbu does one thing.

features.name: Contracts
features.description: Contracts listed among document types in the screenshots.
features.reason: Outside the single job of invoicing.

features.name: Account and cross-device sync
features.description: Sign-up and data stored on the developer's servers, shared across devices and the web app.
features.reason: No accounts, data on the device.

features.name: Region, currency and date format
features.description: Settings > Region: language, currency, date format, tax year with a live preview.
features.reason: FormatStyle with the user's locale and a chosen currency code.

features.name: Default notes and labels
features.description: Default notes for invoices and estimates, custom labels for quantity and rate, default email message.
features.reason: Saves retyping; local settings.

features.name: Duplicate a document
features.description: Not present according to a 1-star review; users ask for it to reuse an estimate as a template.
features.reason: Cheap and asked for explicitly.

screens.name: Invoice list
screens.purpose: History of invoices, the starting point.
elements: rows with client name and number on the left, amount and due date on the right
bottom tab bar: Invoices, Estimates, Expenses, Payments, More

screens.name: Document editor (Edit tab)
screens.purpose: Fill in an invoice or estimate.
elements: totals: subtotal, discount, tax, total, balance due
Mark Paid or Make Invoice button at the bottom

screens.name: Preview
screens.purpose: See the rendered PDF as the client will.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Timeline of sent, opened and paid events for the document.

screens.name: Template picker
elements: Style tab with colour presets and custom hex

screens.name: Settings
elements: Region (language, currency, date format, tax year) with preview
Tax (on total, deducted, per item; rate, label, inclusive)

flows.name: First invoice
steps: add items with rate and quantity
tap send, choose email or text

flows.name: Set tax defaults
steps: choose on total, deducted or per item

fields.name: taxID
fields.note: reviews ask for client VAT number and fiscal code

data_model.storage: Account on the developer's servers, synced across devices and web. For Sbu: SwiftData on device.

monetization.model: Free download, subscription. Free use is capped (the listing says the first two documents are free; the help centre says Essentials allows up to 3 invoices a month).
monetization.price: Essentials 6.99 USD/month or 69.99/year, Plus 13.49/month or 134.99/year, Premium 19.99-21.99/month (web sources disagree); some users bought 10-invoice packs.
paywalled_features: more than the free invoice quota
PDF export after building a document
monetization.notes: Reviews report the paywall appearing only at export, after the document was written, and difficulty cancelling.

user_pains.pain: Paywall at export after the work is done, free app is not really free
user_pains.evidence: reviews: export forces a paid subscription without warning; 'free' only for a few minutes; deleted on seeing the subscription

user_pains.pain: Not compliant with Italian invoicing: no client VAT number or fiscal code, no multiple rates, no withholding, INPS 4%, Enasarco, stamp duty, flat-rate regime
user_pains.evidence: reviews asking for P.IVA/CF of the client, multiple rates, ritenuta d'acconto, rivalsa INPS, marca da bollo, regime forfettario; 'not legal'
review asking whether e-invoicing will be possible

user_pains.pain: Crashes, white screens, slow PDF after updates
user_pains.evidence: reviews on iPad and iPhone 12 Pro Max, slow PDF generation
review asking for a year for duplicate
lost all 2017 invoices; sync issues between devices; no quick client search
